changes.before: The target's next activation becomes Attack, Defend or Wander, chosen randomly. Applying Confusion removes Berserk. A negative Morale forfeiture consumes Confusion. Dispel removes pending Confusion. This spell is unavailable until its forced activation and AI implementation are complete.
changes.after: The target's next activation becomes Attack, Defend or Wander, chosen randomly. Attack approaches its chosen enemy if no attack is in reach; if no legal attack or approach is possible, it Defends. Wander also Defends if no legal destination exists. Applying Confusion removes Berserk. A negative Morale forfeiture consumes Confusion. Dispel removes pending Confusion.

none.description: Choose one friendly living, non-mechanical stack. It gains at least double offensive attacks, unlimited retaliations, Flying and native Jousting (+5% damage per charged hex). Existing stronger abilities are retained. Only one stack per original army may be Chosen; a successful recast replaces the previous effect. Nominal duration is min(4, 2 + floor(School coefficient x raw Spell Power / 150)); Expert Light coefficient is 1.45. Spellcraft does not strengthen this duration.

changes.before: Enchant one friendly ranged-capable stack for 3 rounds. After each ranged creature attack that deals damage, the damaged enemy stack gains one Arcane Breach mark; the hit that applies a mark does not benefit from it. A stack can hold at most 3 marks, and applying a mark refreshes all existing marks to 2 rounds. Focus Magic captures its caster's Spell Power-derived penetration when cast, and each mark copies that value: min(20%, 10% + 0.05% x Spell Power x Sorcery rank coefficient). Under saved v3 rules, the coefficient is 100% with no rank, 115% at Basic, 130% at Advanced, and 145% at Expert; it scales only the Spell Power term, leaving the 10% base unchanged. Saved v1/v2 profiles use 100% at every Sorcery rank. Subsequent friendly ranged creature attacks ignore that much Creature Defense; Creature Defense is not reduced, and melee attacks gain no benefit.
changes.after: Enchant one friendly ranged-capable stack for 3 rounds. After each ranged creature attack that deals damage, the damaged enemy stack gains one Arcane Breach mark; the hit that applies a mark does not benefit from it. A stack can hold at most 3 marks, and applying a mark refreshes all existing marks to 2 rounds. Focus Magic captures its caster's Spell Power-derived penetration when cast, and each mark copies that value: the captured revised formula is min(12%, 5% + 0.03% x Spell Power x Sorcery rank coefficient); historical profiles retain min(20%, 10% + 0.05% x Spell Power x Sorcery rank coefficient). Under saved v3 rules, the coefficient is 100% with no rank, 115% at Basic, 130% at Advanced, and 145% at Expert; it scales only the Spell Power term, leaving the captured fixed base unchanged. Saved v1/v2 profiles use 100% at every Sorcery rank. Subsequent friendly ranged creature attacks ignore that much Creature Defense; Creature Defense is not reduced, and melee attacks gain no benefit.
